title_en: Good News (2/20): A Renewable Energy Record
note_en: 随着 means "as" or "along with" when one change brings another: 随着越来越多的海上风力发电场建成 "as more and more offshore wind farms are built." The 随着 clause always comes first and sets up the change; the main clause follows, often with 也 or 随之 ("along with it"), as in 发电量也随之明显提升 "and power output has risen noticeably along with it."
